item.title: REJECT Launches Supporter Sponsorship Plan! Corporate Logo Placement Now Available on Official Website - Saiga NAK
item.description: REJECT Inc. has launched REJECT Supporter, a new sponsorship plan designed to support the activities and goals of the esports team REJECT. Benefits include naming rights and corporate logo placement on the official REJECT website.

item.title: CAPTAIN TSUBASA 2: WORLD FIGHTERS System Trailer Released! New Systems Will Make Matches More Exciting - Saiga NAK
item.description: Bandai Namco Entertainment has released the system trailer for CAPTAIN TSUBASA 2: WORLD FIGHTERS, a soccer action game scheduled for release in 2026 on PlayStation 5, Nintendo Switch, Xbox Series X|S, and Steam.

item.title: New Agent Miks Joins VALORANT! A Music-Themed Controller - Saiga NAK
item.description: New Controller agent Miks has been added to the tactical FPS VALORANT. Featuring exceptional support capabilities, this character specializes in team play.

item.title: Capcom's First Managed Store Outside Japan, CAPCOM STORE, Opens in Taipei on March 20! Limited Goods and Campaigns Also Available - Saiga NAK
item.description: CAPCOM CO., LTD. has announced that it will open CAPCOM STORE TAIPEI, the first location outside Japan for its managed store CAPCOM STORE, in Taipei on Friday, March 20, 2026. The store is located at Shinkong Mitsukoshi Taipei Xinyi Place A11 in Taipei, Taiwan.

item.title: MSI Releases MAG 275UPD E14 Gaming Monitor in Japan! Features Dual Mode to Switch Between 4K / 144Hz and Full HD / 288Hz - Saiga NAK
item.description: MSI Computer Japan announced the release of the MAG 275UPD E14 gaming monitor on Thursday, March 19, 2026. It features a Dual Mode that allows users to freely switch between 4K / 144Hz and Full HD / 288Hz.

item.title: Popular Cyborg-Style ROG Gaming Chairs Arrive in Japan! Featuring the ROG Destrier Ergo and Standard ROG Destrier Core With Sound-Insulating Panels - Saiga NAK
item.description: ASUS announced that it will release the popular cyborg-style ROG Destrier Ergo Gaming Chair and ROG Destrier Core Gaming Chair on Friday, March 27, 2026.

item.title: Yohji Yamamoto's Apparel Brand WILDSIDE and Yakuza/Like a Dragon Collaborate on Tattoo Design Shirts and More! Sales Start March 25 - Saiga NAK
item.description: The fourth collaboration collection between WILDSIDE, an edgy conceptual brand by world-renowned fashion designer Yohji Yamamoto, and Ryu Ga Gotoku Studio, the creators of the Yakuza/Like a Dragon series, has arrived! Sales begin on Wednesday, March 25, 2026, at the WILDSIDE official online store and select retail locations.

item.title: The Smartphone Version of the Popular Mystery Adventure Game Urban Myth Dissolution Center Is Now Available! Featuring Frame Functions and Touch Controls - Saiga NAK
item.description: Shueisha Games Inc. has released the iOS and Android versions of the mystery adventure game Urban Myth Dissolution Center. It has been available since Thursday, March 19, 2026, and can be purchased from the App Store and Google Play.

item.title: Blue Mary Confirmed to Join Fatal Fury: CotW on March 26, 2026! Character Trailer Released! - Saiga NAK
item.description: DLC character Blue Mary will join SNK Corporation's fighting game Fatal Fury: City of the Wolves (hereafter Fatal Fury: CotW) starting Thursday, March 26, 2026! Character trailers have been released in Japanese and English.

item.title: GUILTY GEAR -STRIVE- Ver. 2.00 Update Announced! Jam Kuradoberi Finally Joins the Fight! - Saiga NAK
item.description: Arc System Works Co., Ltd. announced a major update for the popular fighting game GUILTY GEAR -STRIVE-! New elements, including the new character Jam Kuradoberi, have been revealed all at once.
